t:
I can’t tell you how happy I am for your and Dakkar’s success. We must think about our next steps, since now we are not as harmless against Nihaz as we once were. But it’s still not enough...

You should go talk to Zarida now. A ship recently crashed in the Preserve, and for some reason she is greatly disturbed by this... There has to be a reason.
Excellent, we did it. Are you saying the weaker ranks perished alongside their zombie leaders? Yes, it all fits... I think I know how we can solve this problem.
Excellent. I can always count on you. It crashed in the west of the forest. I’ll mark it on the map for you.

Listen, thinking is not your job...!

You are right, but it doesn't matter how close this army is. We must be aware of what's happening around us. Perhaps these things are connected. Let's call it a premonition.

Besides, this is Catherina's domain, and her word is law here. And so is mine while I have her confidence. In short, don't argue with me. The sooner you get this done, the better.
h: I still don’t understand everything. Why do we care about a ship of Free Traders when Nihaz’s army could attack us any minute?

t: Look what the wind blew in. Horse people! Fancy that! They're not even corrupted.

Defeat? That's a bit strong. Although that's the way our songwriters will put it. Naah. We're ordinary people. All we did was pray to gods for it to pass.

I have no idea if it was gods' help or someone else's bright actions, but the Leper is fading. The Queen's guards are doing all they can. Not everyone is happy about their presence, you know.
h: So you managed to defeat the Leper.

t: Go to Amanda de Desirae in Mushroom Ravine with the undead.

Our undead are still so weak. I know this sounds ironic, but they don’t have enough life force.

The simplest option is to start by taking it from someone... If we took the easy way out, a couple villages worth of peasants would do.

As  you know, , that won’t do at all. However, we’re on Umoir and the Leper is everywhere...

Yes, yes, the Leper is the solution. It has an excess of life force. Usually, it has a very destructive effect on the dead. You’ve probably encountered something like that before. But, if we properly collect, store and transfer this energy...

It seems our young talent Amanda has some brilliant ideas. I’m impressed by her bounteous... enthusiasm. Go to her in Mushroom Ravine and solve this problem with her.
At last! I thought Dakkar would never send me anything to work with.

Mushrooms grow like crazy around here, don’t they?

I have a theory about the initial rapid spread of the Leper. Maybe some animal species brought in spores and mycelium that flourished and infected new animals...

We should compare different types of mushrooms and their effects! Unfortunately, several of the kinds that interest us don't like sitting still in the ground. They prefer to wander around snapping their teeth.

It would be great if you could bring me some samples.
Excellent samples. Just what we need!

They burden my gray head with so many things...

First you, , then the elf...

I don’t like elves, they always have such twisted fantasies.

This girl decided to study the Leper, so now we have to help her. But I won’t lift a finger. I have other things to do. Luckily, I have you to carry out idiotic tasks. So you will help her. Collect those mushrooms or whatever else she needs. Now get out of my sight before I get irritated.

Thank you, ! You're a pleasure to work with, unlike this brute.

Oh, this is beautiful mycelium. I can work with this. Of course, it would be good to assess its future growth.
Amanda wants you to collect samples of local plants.

The Leper!

Isn’t it a real wonder?

Different species – animals and plants – exist in one system and interact in symbiosis...

But after you dealt with the Primal Demon in the Ancient Mound, its strength waned, and it began a gradual retreat. However, I think it has stabilized here in the Valley. In order to check my theory, I’ll need some plant samples. Help me gather some.
Wonderful, I can definitely work with this material.

Oh, I wish I hadn’t seen you, hero of Sarnaut.

This elf girl is really stressing me out. She has completely frayed my nerves.

That rookie is even giving orders here! What does she think she’s doing, anyway? But I have a good option here: you deal with her problems.

You see, she needs some plant samples to see whether the Leper is changing. The only plant she’ll get from me is a stick, which I’ll use to smack her little... Hmm, never mind.

Get away from me. Go to her and get what she needs!

These are great samples, ! I’m glad you could help me. As I already told you, I want to understand why the Leper has stabilized in the Valley and stopped retreating!

In order to know for sure, I want to obtain samples of all the plants. I want to compare how they change from day to day.
Help Amanda make chemical concentrates and test them on the undead.

Wonderful!

I managed to synthesize the extracts we need from the samples you brought me... Now I need to make concentrates. And you will assist me!

Alchemy isn’t difficult at all. It’s actually quite fun! I remember my uncle used to experiment on rats... Some of them even started talking! One of them even became our chef! Pretty cool, huh?

Um, why don't you seem excited? Fine, I’ll tell you what to do, and your job is to listen closely and do as I say. Just don’t get confused.

Three failures in a row. I’ll bet that’s what you think. But this is what I think: this isn’t failure, it’s an alternative outcome! After all, how to give sentience to a corpse or turn it into a mushroom is useful knowledge, no? Sure, that isn't what we were looking for...

But what does this mean? It means we need to keep trying!
Collect the essence of termite warriors and three termite queens.

We didn’t get much from the mushrooms. But I have a new idea. Just listen...

What is the best adapted species in Sarnaut that is even mostly impervious to Zem venoms?

What do you mean, goblins?

I’m talking about termites! Remember, once they even appeared somehow in the capital cities. People completely panicked, screaming about an invasion and how everyone would be eaten!

But here is what I noticed: since our expedition arrived in Umoir, termite numbers have only grown! You know what that means? Termites are now the most resilient part of the Leper ecosystem. We’ll start to gather life force from them.

Oh, what amazing life force!

This is just what we need for our helpers.
Collect the essence of termite warriors and three termite queens.

Where have you been?

Don't you see what's happening? Our undead are dying, they lie down and don't get up. That's because there's not enough life force. Summoning is a tricky business - you have to take it from somewhere to pass it along. You can't create it out of nothing!

We need to kill someone fast. Maybe I should kill you, ? Or this Amanda?

Ah, never mind, I'd probably get more life force from a cat. Kill those... bugs. The local termites. Pick fat ones.  When you're done, take the essence to the elf, she'll have someone deliver it.
That’s what we needed, thank you! I’ll send it to that evil wizard. But he’ll be busy if the termites manage to create their own civilization. Look how they’ve progressed already.

, as you can see, infected termites don’t build mounds. It looks like they've taken up a nomadic lifestyle. Just imagine – an army of termites endlessly marching and wiping away everything in its path!

And these queens are somehow less worried about their offspring. Look how many of them were left behind during their “excursions” in the swamps!

Since the termites aren’t caring for them, they could be useful in our experiments... as their eggs must contain the concentrated life energy needed to develop larvae.
All the eggs are whole, great. Wonder how the termites lose them…

I thought up a potion. I will give it to you, , and the zombies. For good health!

No, you can’t refuse, you’ll drink it...

But I need ingredients. Mushrooms and corpse fluid are everywhere...  there's lots of swamp water and owl droppings too.

So. I need termite eggs! Enter the swamp and get me some eggs. Then leave them with that idiot. She’ll pass them on when convenient.
Thank you. But keep out of Nawlad's sight for now, or else he'll force-feed you his decoctions.
It’s so dark and pretty here!
Destroy the annoying mosquitoes swarming above the swamp.

So many mosquitoes! You are a true hero. Finally, I get a quick minute to relax.

Of course, the buzzing didn't go anywhere. Hear it? Yes?

Glory to Tensess. I was starting to think I was truly out of my mind.
Inject Veligrad fighters with the Leper.

And now we are moving to the final stage of our experiments! I am adding the termite essence you gathered to my new potion. This will be pure Leper essence, a high-grade concentrate. And you will test it on the dead. If something goes wrong, you’ll have an easier time managing... unforeseen circumstances than me, a fragile elf.

I made a magic seal that will help properly direct the action of the concentrate. Stand next to it and make the dead line up single file. When they stand over the seal – stick them.

Brilliant! Simply brilliant! Just look! These beauties are simply brimming with life force!

Figuratively speaking, of course...
Talk to Zarida about the problem in Wellebell Preserve.

Well, , in the  eyes of the locals we look like grave robbers, but it looks like we got what we wanted. Sarnaut has never seen such power as this army has.

Now we need to load it on Eclipse, which will take some time. There isn't very much space for it here, and new dead are constantly being added – our spells will keep local cemeteries and churchyards empty for a long time.

But this is not the time to relax! We have a small chance to improve our relationship with the locals. Something is wrong in Wellebell. Yes, that whole thing with that ship that brought... and Tep knows what those goblins found. The monster that killed them continued on its path of blood and is now preying on the locals. So go to Zarida. She is waiting for you in the Preserve.

Oh, !

I’ve been waiting a long time for you. It seems the smuggler shipped that crashed here was actually carrying something far worse than leper animals...

I’d like to think we can just teleport there... And that’s exactly what we’re going to do! At first the problem was pretty obvious: no matter how strong I am, I just don't know where to teleport us, but then Gala came to my aid.

The House de Delice is famous for its portal magic, but also for the number of lovers had by its leader, Antoinette de Delice!

So Gala promised that her experimental teleporter would let me teleport right to the draconids own teleporter. I don’t know how exactly this works, but it’s our only chance.
h: But how do we get there?

t: Do you realize HOW MANY draconids are on that island? We don't need another war. Our only chance is to quietly snatch the key! And quickly move it to Eclipse. After all the delays at the beginning, local intrigues and showdowns with vampires and goblins… Let’s just say we don’t have much time left. Go see Gala now. Actually... If you want to learn more about the Keys, I think you should talk to Zayan.
h: Why don't we just send a division of undead over there instead?

t: Deal with the monster living in the ruined tower.

The local population is seriously alarmed. They say a monster appeared recently and is living in the ruined tower...

A girl disappeared here just recently... and a sheep before that. No one has seen anything concrete. The creature is faster than the wind and ethereal like mist. You can’t grab it or strike it with a sword! They say it looks more like a girl than a man – she has braids!

They were apple to track the creature – she's taken up in an old tower across the river. There were horrible screams coming from there, so they were afraid to go any further. They say this monster drinks blood... I think, , everything is quite clear to you, yes?

If this really is a strong vampire – we need it. I’ll give you a chain strong enough to drag a bull. Go there and come back alive with the vampire!
And now the toughest part – what should I do with her?
Decide what to do next with Annette.

Hmm. Annette de Tristesse, Ademar’s daughter?

So you already got to meet her, ? I know this story... it’s a sad one, of course. Annette could have been our chance, but... It seems it’s too late.

Curses! How did they find out so fast, ? Did someone tell them?

I’ve heard about this Hiero... he won’t listen to anyone. Listen... Roxane thinks Annette can still be saved...

Even aside from the fact that I’m not about to give my friend’s daughter to some fanatic so he can burn her alive, she could still be useful. She is... an incredibly strong vampire. Stronger than Wigo. She could unite the rest of the pack under her... Do you understand how good that could be for us?

The bad part is Hiero won’t wait for long... We need to act right now!
Get Canaan’s Blood and treat Annette.

Sometimes these two are worse than kids...

I have a solution to the problem, but it’s not that simple.

We need the blood of the first vampire. Yes, yes, the very first vampire ever. Where do we get it?

Does the name ‘Canaan’ mean anything to you? There are few who know this story. It’s a dark chapter in the history of our people... and, obviously, we have tried to forget it. There was a time when the Conclave of Great Mages was made up of only elves. One of them was Canaan. He was a powerful mage, but he sought a way to increase his might further. He studied the June relics.

Needless to say, it didn’t end well. That was when the Conclave had its first split, and the elven Great Mages issued bans on certain forms of magic. The tragedy of Canaan and his vampire followers became known as the Bloody Feast.

I won’t go into the whole story with you. Suffice to say the following: Canaan was defeated by the famous Avelina. His body was buried here on Umoir. Skrakan promised to faithfully guard his tomb.

However, though Canaan was defeated, he never completely died. He... still has influence over other vampires. He summons them. Amarantha wasn’t built here for nothing, you know. Even if Wigo won't admit it, he was summoned here by the ancient vampire, who desired a resurrection.

Your mission with Dakkar is simple: scout the outskirts of Amarantha and find a way into the tomb. I will give you a special bottle. All you need to do is bring it to his grave. Let magic do the rest... AND UNDER NO CIRCUMSTANCES should you otherwise disturb Canaan!
Why are you just standing there? I’ll get busy with the medicine. Go to Zayan!
Find the missing pages of Danas's Guide to Allods.

A heavy ancient tome. Title: Danas's Guide to Allods. A great hero of the past wrote down his stories here. It's missing some pages. What a pity. Collect all pages of this book near the Crooked Outpost and learn more about Danas's travels.
Find all documents, lost in Dale.

This is only an empty folder. It's up to you to fill it up. Mail isn't always reliable. Even rare historical evidence can be lost in transit. Here you will store everything you can find, whether it's important or not. It's empty. Collect all documents you can find in Dale.
You have found all documents in Dale. You have a large folder full of pages, newspaper articles, magazines, and such.
Find the missing letters from Skrakan's archive.

Skrakan has been corresponding with the Great Mages for thousands of years. His letters are stored in his archive. Someone plundered Skrakan's archives. Many letters were lost, some of them - forever. Perhaps, you can restore some of them. Who knows what secrets you can find. Collect all documents near the Witch's Lair and learn more about them.
You managed to gather Skrakan's missing letters.
Find all lost pages of Urd's book.

A grim black book with a handwritten note inside. "Heed this warning, one who reads this. This is a book of chronicles of the Soul Master, the Great Mage Urd. This is forbidden knowledge. I managed to translate some of his notes and show him for who he was. It also contains abstracts from Yazes's Chronicles that explore his deeds." It's a shame that it's missing some pages. Collect all pages of this book near the Witch's Lair and learn more about it.
Find the all missing pages of the History of Vampires.

A fancy red book. It contains the vampires' history. Zayan could be the author. Apparently, this book was stolen, or came to the owner some other way. It's missing some pages. What a pity. Collect all pages in Amarantha and near Apostate Vampires' camps and learn more about them.
You managed to gather the History of Vampires's missing pages.
Collect the lost pages of Veligrad chronicles in the ruins and around them.

A volume of Veligrad legends. It covers the entire history. Why the city was founded, what it was supposed to keep, what led it to decay, and what happened next. It's missing some pages. What a pity. Collect all pages of this book in Veligrad and at the Galenel tower to learn more about the city history.
You have collected all books! You have unlocked all chronicles.
You have collected all pages of the Chronicle of the Valirs!

This is the Chronicle of the Valirs that covers the origins of Kania, the orcish war, the great deeds of nobility, and the Valir dynasty. It's missing some pages. Collect all pages of this book near the Clear Valley and learn more about Kanian nobility.
Find out from Klavdia where to look for the next key.

You did well. Zayan and Dakkar will begin to load the army on board of Eclipse. Zarida, Catherina's apprentice will stay here. Besides, another necromant, Nawlad Jeer will soon arrive. We tried to get him involved since the very beginning, but he has a short temper. Negotiations took a very long time.

At least, he can take care of the undead, arriving here. In any case, we'll have a power reserve. I also asked other Zayan's apprentices to visit other allods, full of the walking dead. Urd's knowledge will help us subdue them. All of them.

The League and Imperial troops are placed on the correct positions. Their task is to hold the astral regions, where unusual activity was spotted.

And then there's Sculptor. He has his own plans for this war, but I prefer to leave him alone for now.

There's just one but. We know, where the Seal is and what's on it. We need the Key to open the way.

Klavdia should know where to find it. Ask her about the details and go for it.
Oh, do you have the teleporter? It looks like everything works... Well, , back on the road?
Get to Heart of Fire island and get the Key.
I see no reason to move slowly, since we’re all ready. As soon as we leave the Outpost, Cosmos will announce departure preparations. Talk to me when everything is finished... I may return alone.

Well, that went better than expected... We almost died, of course, but that’s normal.

But I didn’t expect to. Did you understand what that wormface said? It sounds like Agrus is preparing something... I wonder if Soliskar knows he is gathering an entire army of those creatures.

Apparently, we aren’t the only ones preparing for war with Nihaz. But something tells me the draconids will not be our allies.
Take money for the medicine to Velerad.

These elvish noble squabbles are inappropriate. The Leper surrounds us, and we have more problems than we know what to do with, as you can see.

But the wilds are gradually retreating. Order is winning. That’s where the Guardian Ring, a gathering of Keepers, helps us. They have protected the ecosystem on our allod for ages... a-a...
aah-choo!

Excuse me! I haven’t been entirely well lately. I’ve been breathing in those damn mushroom spores again. You should go see the Keepers, ask about a healing potion for me, and pay them. And if they need help with anything – be a friend and help them out.
I’m glad to see you, ! I remember what you did, how you helped us. As for the prince’s medicine, it will be ready in time, don’t worry.
Clear the area of infected creatures.

What, , Vseslav said we needed help? Yes, he's right, we do indeed.

Look around you! Umoir is an ancient land. Once it was a beautiful place. With oak groves full of animals and birds, clean lakes and fields...

All of that ended when the Leper showed up here! Clear Valley became Foul. And though you heroes killed off a good portion of the infected animals, the Valley remains the most dangerous and wild place on Umoir. Those creatures getting into the capital or Al Rihat are coming from here.

Our only hope to get rid of the Leper is our, the Keepers’, hard work to heal the land itself. Alas, the creatures get in the way of that. With a heavy heart, I ask you to put them at rest. And we’ll think about what else we can do.
What do the trees and grasses whisper? What does the wind sing through the canopy?
You did what had to be done. Though I am saddened to end life, it looks like we had no other option.
Clear the area of infected creatures.

Well, , you are my friend. Our Keepers have come to me with another request. Cursed leper creatures continue to rage. They wander the remaining wilderness and prevent the land from being healed. There is only one way to deal with them.

Kill them all.

Alas, it is a tough choice, but there is no other way. Do what you must.
What do the trees and grasses whisper? What does the wind sing through the canopy?
Well, you did what had to be done, friend. Though I am saddened to end life, it looks like we had no other option.
Find and bring four creatures to the healing totem: a mutant toad, gulper, galactic deer and taksa.

No matter what, the Leper is strong. Many years will pass before this land is completely healed. Great labors stand before us. After all, we know how to help and turn back this cursed infection.

See the ring of totems over there? It contains all the power of the defenders of Umoir. It heals the land with its grace. It can also heal the mad children of the Leper. Come and help us, !

Take a strong lasso, catch the animals, and bring them to the ring. Though they will resist you, remember you are only helping them. We can’t heal them all, but we can at least return some of them to their true nature.
Mother Earth loves all her creatures. Remember that.
Wonderful! Starting is the hardest part! Now look how cute they are.
Find and bring two of each of four creatures to the healing totem: a mutant toad, gulper, galactic deer and taksa.

We feel bad for the creatures. Don’t think about it, . You can’t heal them all, but you can help some. Let’s try to save a few.

So, take a lasso and drag infected animals to the totem set up by our Keepers.

The power of grace there will overcome the Leper’s shackles and help the animal heal.

We can’t save them all, but we have to try.
Mother Earth loves all her creatures. Remember that.
Look how happy they are now, and the ecosystem with them.
Clear the area of galactic deer.

There is one more problem here besides the Leper...

Some hunters appeared recently. Goblins!

They catch infected beasts and carry them off somewhere. It’s not clear why exactly, but I think they’re up to no good. You see, , for now the Leper has only consumed Umoir and surrounding islands, but what if it travels elsewhere? Although the infection is now in decline, who knows...

And those poachers are setting traps here. It’s a foul deed. If an animal falls into a trap, it suffers greatly. Do me a favor and disarm those traps.
Well, how is it going with the traps?
Thank you so much, ! These tormentors showed up at an evil hour on Umoir. They have caused much harm.
Protect the northern idol from attacking goblin troublemakers while John restores its power.

Oh, pain and suffering!

Among other things, those bastards aren’t just setting traps, they’re also trying to harm us!

They set our healing totem on fire and now they're trying to topple it over! They don't seem to like the fact that we're putting things in order here and healing the land and animals...

, you scatter those goblins and help me while I enchant it again!
There! They won’t even get a sliver! If the idol could move, it would give them a good beating. But while it’s still growing, it needs protection from troublemakers. Serves them right!
Find and eliminate the reason why the healed animals escaped.

Well, a deed done is soon disputed. One thing worries me – where are some of the animals running off to? What pulls them back to infected lands? This can't be good.

Listen, , try to follow them. Find out what, or more likely who, is calling them there. I have one idea...

Be careful. No matter what you face, remember – our cause is just.
He was once a Keeper of the Guardian Ring. Long ago, before the Leper. Now no one remembers his name. I hope he's at peace now.

This mission is more important than anything right now. But it would be going much faster without interference.

Yes, yes, , I’m talking about those little wretches! I don’t know what drives them, but they’ve caused immense harm.

Though we are friends to all things living, we cannot let this stand any longer. They have a small camp not far away. Do me a favor and pursue them until even their spirits flee this place! I will talk to Zarida to find out what to do about this problem once and for all.

I see you’re not wasting any time here. That’s good. John already told me everything.

And who is this person talking behind you? A prisoner? Why surrender alive!? I guess that goblin tricked you. Settle the matter so we can be done with it.

Although...

No, let him live for now.

I'm quite useful! I know a lot, and I can do a lot! I'll tell you everything!

Don't hit me!

I guess that’s it!

We made it just in time. The Mistress herself just arrived, along with Zayan and the rest.

Well, all that’s left is to hand over the Outpost to you. Make yourselves comfortable here, but don't go to Clear Valley just yet with your undead, otherwise...

Eyes on me, ! If something goes wrong, I’ll be looking at you! And yes, if I need anything, I’ll call you. Don’t think you can just escape me!
What happened here? It looks like a massacre...

What? You're saying the goblins were collecting animals for some Xadaganian? Strange things are afoot.

But it doesn’t matter! The time has come to carry out our plan. Catherina couldn’t have found a better spot. Do you know its history?

No? I remember you have serious gaps in your memory, . We need to give you a crash course on the history of our academy when all this ends.  Yes, yes, with mandatory exams!

You know what we’ll do? I’d like to introduce you to my assistants. These are the best of the best I could find. Perhaps you have already met some of them...

Go around to all of them and ask for their views on this matter.
This is almost a dream team. Of course, we could find more necromancy specialists... But only those who are ready to drop everything and come here right away.
My dear friend! I have not forgotten your help.
Meet with Catherina in the Sunken Garden.

Well, let’s begin. The first question we need to answer: is our  plan realistic at all?

For that, Catherina wants to do a series of tests on the demon you pulled from the Infinity.

She's already waiting nearby for us... It’s not polite to make the Queen wait, so I suggest we go there right away.

Ah, you’re still alive. Wonderful. Time to get to business, don’t you think?

By the way, thanks for your help with our little inconvenient problem at the Outpost, . Zarida, of course, did most of the work, but you were very helpful too.
Someday we will give Veligrad a worthy renovation. Or rebuild it.
Erect a magical barrier around the undead enclosure.

Let’s get to work!

We need to wall off this area. After all, we don’t want anyone escaping, do we?

My apprentices already started installing the primary security pylons. , help them out and we can find out if Zayan’s plan is realistic or just an old man’s fantasy.

What took you so long?

Remember, if the barrier breaks and the undead escape, that’ll be entirely your fault.
Destroy the crawlers, their eggs and larvae in and around the Sunken Garden.

Ewww... So disgusting.

No, I’m not talking about you, . Just look around. Those... insects are everywhere!

Hey, do me a favor, kill all of them, please. I can’t even concentrate. I feel sick all the time just looking at them.

No, don't come any closer! You stink of their filthy slime two fathoms away.

It’s good to be finished with them.
Eliminate the Crawlers, their eggs and larvae around the Flooded Garden and report to Nawlad Jeer.

Those stupid girls from Catherina's retinue are scared to death of a bunch of bugs... Hah! As if that’s the scariest thing they can imagine...

But believe me, every part of nature is important – even rats, roaches and fleas.

However, they could interfere with our plans. Just look, vast numbers of them have appeared around the Sunken Garden. They are messing with the undead gathered there. Some are getting bitten and others completely devoured. It falls to you, , to rid us of this nuisance. Why are you making a face? Get to it, come on.
Killing some vile things – sounds like a job for you. Come back again later. Those things breed fast.
Help Catherina experiment on the demon.

Everything is ready for the experiment.

We know these things can warp the Spark of any living creature. Based on your observations, , that ability has no effect on the undead – or at least not like the Zem.

Now we need to find out the following:

First: how does it affect undead with no Spark at all?

Second: how does it affect vampires who were influenced by the Darkness similarly to the Zem? If you remember, the Arisen came to be after Tep killed them with his plague. The vampires came to be after performing the rituals of the very same Tep, or they came under the influence of a certain dark artifact – the Dark Mirror, apparently. Darkness played a role in both cases.

We think the effect of the Darkness created its own sort of immunity in the Spark to further manipulations.

It's good to have your... toothy friend with us. We'll test both hypotheses.

The experiment was successful. Our hypothesis was confirmed.

I’ll admit, , I didn’t think it would work. It seems Nihaz made a mistake. That gives us a chance.

Now you and Dakkar must act. You may need to raise every churchyard and cemetery on Umoir, but we need to gather an army. I hope Dakkar’s warriors aren’t as flimsy as these test zombies.
Find out what is happening to you

What happened with the vampires puts us in a difficult position. I need some time to think everything over. Go discuss your condition with Roxane for now. I doubt anyone will give you a better consultation around here than her.
Well, feel better? Great. I see you can fight, so march over to Zayan. Ah, well yes... Here, take this. Here's a jar of blood. It’s not much but enough for starters.
Since you’re feeling better, I think you should return to Zayan. We need to hurry. As for vampirism... I think you’ll get used to it quickly.
We’re here. Let me know when you've gathered your strength and are ready to move out. Don’t expect every ghost to be glad of our arrival and intentions.

Now listen especially closely. You already visited these places and you know about the robber camp. These poor fellows have performed their show for so long. Let’s try to make their future more useful to someone. There has to be something around here controlling them, and our goal is to find it and destroy it.
Now, we can begin our investigations.
Hurry up, we don't have much time.

h: I am ready to move out.

t: I will give you a magiscope and mark several points on the map, they're all in the camp. Measure the magic field at each point but be very careful! We are interested in any anomaly.

What do you mean “no anomalies?”

Something has to be keeping the ghosts here!

Okay, we need to act quickly and decisively. I doubt Nihaz will like what we're plotting...

There is one interesting option. I will send you to the Ghostly World, and you ask them yourself!

Don’t worry, it’s not dangerous – you can always come back, but don’t return until you find out what’s going on here.
Okay, maybe this has just become more complicated, but all you need to do is move into the ghostly world and find out at least something. , talk to me when you are feeling better.
Did you find anything? A portal? No, I've never heard anything like that...
Investigate what lies on the other side of the portal.

So. A portal? In the Ghostly World? That is not in the real world?

I think that’s what we need. I don't even want to think about what lies beyond it. It must be some kind of... Underside of the World? The reverse side of our reality, where a god as high as Nihaz spun his spells?

, you have already been down many Secret Paths... and even other worlds like the Fractal of the Architects. So – charge forth, and fear nothing. Then tell me what you see. We need to find out how the God of Darkness is holding them.
What did you see through the portal?
Unbelievable! I must see this all for myself... But later. First – to business. I feel that the ghosts are getting free and we need to use this moment!
Protect Dakkar while he performs the ritual.

Finally, I can begin the ritual! Most likely some of the ghosts will reject any attempts to control them after liberation. Although they should be quite weak after such a shock, I really can't be sure what to expect from them... I need your protection.
Why are you standing there? Protect me!
Oof, I thought that was the end of us. I need to get out of here quick and report my success to Zayan.
Get to the Outpost and tell Zayan what happened.
I can stand on my own, the ghosts are calm now... Don't ask anything. Let's get back to the Outpost first.

Wow, what a story... You call it the Underside? Great name. I don’t think it’s going anywhere, and we can come back to study it later. I’m glad you accomplished this mission and managed to come back alive, both of you. Take a break, and then come speak with me. While you were gone, something strange happened.
Did you get Canaan's blood? That’s great news. Maybe we can change Hiero’s mind...

, are you saying Svetlana told Hiero about Annette? And she stood behind the nobles?

Well, that is sad... and alas, predictable.

I’m afraid she won’t be able to forgive so easy. What happened to her left an indelible mark on her. I only hope that with time I can convince her... But for now, she should return to the children.

I understand you still have little experience controlling the dead, but it’s quite simple –  they will unquestioningly obey any order you give them.

Remember two things: they are already dead and the “life” in them is sustained through your life. That means all damage they take is redirected to you. But that also works in the reverse:  what gives them strength, also fortifies you. I doubt you’ll be able to even lift a weapon – all your concentration will go towards maneuvering the troops.

I’ll give you the best, use their powers wisely. Well, are you ready to do what must be done?

There is little time, so listen to everything right now...

We will throw our main forces into fighting the Templars on the bridge and outside the walls of the Outpost. We can’t let them take it, but some troops will probably get in!

You stay here. Urd's knowledge allows me to give you a squad of undead that will be strong enough for your mind and soul.  Try to take care of them.
With Annette’s help, get Amaranth’s vampires to join your army.

Good. Looks like another problem solved. We’re almost done... Vampires – we need them, but now we have Annette. She is strong enough for the others to follow her.

And yes, we also need to handle your problem, . We have the antidote, but will you agree to testing it on yourself? Excellent, I didn't expect any hesitation.

Talk to Roxane, then go to Amaranth.
Everything was too simple. Honorable behavior for such a pitiful creature!
Oh, well great! We’ll save some antidote...
h: No, I want to stay a vampire.

t: Tell Zayan that the vampires will join his army.

You know, now I’m starting to think about what happens after... If there is an “after,” of course...

We vampires are outcasts from two Elven Houses! Even if Gala’s plan works, I don’t think we will be welcomed back as members of society... they will always fear us.

Perhaps my destiny has always been to become the ruler of exiles. And the curse of the Evil Mirror is actually a blessing?

Tell Zayan the vampires will help us. I’ll stay here and restore order. And the antidote... , use it on those who remain in Drowsy Woods. I hope Yelisseus can forgive me.

Umoir. The Leper has changed it. It is stronger than before. Not many value this Gift, but it will help us all in the end, believe me. I am glad to see everything through my own eyes.

, are you saying an undead army has already been marshaled?

Excellent, excellent!

Now we are ready to face our mutual enemy! Nihaz... Nihaz... One day I will say this name for the last time!

We still have to plan out the attack itself.
Stormbringer... I haven't seen you in a while.

I’m finished with the code. Our plan is quite clear, but... Let’s just say I doubt the locals on Umoir will like it. I will give you instructions. They are only meant for you and Dakkar. The others will have to do without this information... No one besides us can save this world.

I understand you have been to such places before, but still, before we go, let me remind you of several rules: we must be quiet as ghosts in the Mound. We can’t attract any attention or react to anything. Ideally, we will casually stroll to the main hall as if nothing is wrong, where we will conduct the ritual, disturbing as few of its residents as possible. Well, shall we go?

I am more than satisfied with what we accomplished, despite these screamers. The main thing is to remember that this is a temporary and lesser evil. And the people... In a day they will forget everything. You’ll see.
Take the Veligrad fighters to the Outpost and show them to Dakkar.

I am incredibly proud of the work you and I have accomplished. It’s a real breakthrough! Both in terms of necromancy and studying the effects of the Leper.

I want to show the results to Dakkar immediately. , take your soldiers to the Outpost. Let him enjoy the sight!

Are these our new warriors? Exquisite! How did you and Amanda manage that? I want to know all the details.

...No-no, not right now. A bit later when we finish some messy business. For now, let them take their places in the ranks.
Collect astral amber from the bottom of the lake.

I need... working material. Past experience has showed me that astral amber works best for this...

This lake is highly unusual. On one side we have the Leper. The very manifestation of Chaos! And on the other side is a meteorite. As you already now, it is directly connected to Order!

What happens when one collides with the other? We're about to find out!

What are you standing there for, ? Get in the lake and get some amber!

How they shine! Excellent – that’s just what we needed.

This time we’ll do without vulgar fools. We’ll get some fresh material!
Collect blood from the irradiated creatures inhabiting the lake.

, since you already have to get in the lake for our honorable sculptor, why not check out one more theory?

As you see, there is a chunk of meteorite in the middle of the lake. Not too long ago, it was just a crater. But several years ago the meteorite started showing signs of life. This was before the invasion of the Architects on Dane... Catherina decided to sink the crater just in case.

Then some unusual local fauna quickly spread here. That’s what we need. I want to use the blood of these creatures to determine the essence of the Order within the meteorite. Then I’ll use it to try to strengthen our undead. So, what do you say? I knew you would agree.
Great work! We must use everything we can in the fight against Nihaz!
Collect blood from the irradiated creatures inhabiting the lake and report to Jeer.

So that elf wants to “strengthen the undead with the blood of lake creatures.”

I don’t know what new strange ideas he's come up with, but we’ll do as he says.

Oh, did I say we? You’ll do everything, . Get in that lake, get what we need, and then I’ll decide what to do with that blood.
What a fantasy. Some blood. Some meteorite. This didn't happen before!
Use an air bubble to lift sunken undead to the surface.

Something else came up. Some of our soldiers wandered off when we were marching from the Garden to the Outpost. I hear they were seen heading towards the lake. I suspect those unfortunate zombies are wandering the lake bottom now and feeding the eels. Please find them and bring them back to the surface.
That's everyone. I recounted. I hope they didn’t get too waterlogged hanging out on the bottom.
Lift the sunken undead from the lake bottom using an air bubble, then report to Jeer.

Those clueless undead are almost as bad as you, !

What to do. They got off track again and went right into the lake. Now they're just standing there. I don't know what they're waiting for.

You’ll have to dive after them and get them back to me somehow. I’ll be watching over here while you dive.
The soak didn’t do too much harm. Okay, it’ll do.
Take part in Stephane’s secret plot.

I think everything is ready. Now we better hide from curious eyes. The act of creation does not need spectators!

At the other end of the lake there is a secluded place where we can carry out our plan! It’s important we get it right this time!

You're saying the Aoidos you created claimed to serve Nihaz? Interesting.

, I’m sorry, but I don't share Kora’s concerns. If Cosmos was against us, he would have wiped us from the face of this reality a long time ago. I think the whole thing is Stephane’s mistake. Remember, the first time he created an astral demon! And perhaps Nihaz wants us all to fight so he found a way to intervene?

Of course, I’ll keep an eye on Cosmos. But right now, believe me, he’s on our side. To finish with the Dark God’s threat is his greatest desire.
I hope no one saw you coming here. This is very very secret business.

You're here? Good.

We’ll begin the brief.

Our goal is to try to create life. Yes, no more and no less!

To that end, we need: first of all, energy from the Well of Souls... Zayan gave it to me. Second, materials that Zayan gave me but you managed to collect.

Something could go wrong. Or maybe everything will go wrong!

That’s why we had to find a secluded place... where no one would disturb us, and we wouldn’t cause any harm.
Find out from Gala de Delice how her dealings with the vampires are going.

Well, our undead represent some serious power. I’m afraid that just zombies might not be enough. We need to get some more allies. When you and Catherina checked my theory, you had a vampiress with you. Eloise de Doucer, I believe. You probably already know what I'm getting at. House De Doucer. They became vampires. They were exiled and cursed. They could help us. And, I admit, I already knew we would have to ask them for help. The Big Game doesn't stop for a minute... Talk to our dear Gala de Delice. She’ll tell you the plan.
So that’s the setting. Whatever Antoinette and her daughter think, we need the vampires anyway. If I can persuade them, I'll put in a good word for them at the Great Ball.
Wow, what landscapes I have already managed to draw…
Did she tell you using it could tear your arm off? Fine, here.
h: Klavdia told me to take the experimental teleporter away from you.

t: Hmm. Well, I trust him, which means I trust you. Although, if you think about it, nothing could have happened without you. Thank you for saving Eloise. That really moved us along... So, what do you think of this plan: my mother, Great Mage and the head of our House Antoinette de Delice, wants House de Doucer to return to the ranks of the elf Houses. That means amnesty and an end to persecution.
h: Hi, Zayan asked me to find out about your plan.

t: For victory in the Big Game, of course. Our House is graced with many qualities – including diplomacy. Yes, House de Doucer did become vampires... but they remained elves. I think, if they don’t kill anyone, they can certainly find a place among the elves. Perhaps even be cured. I’m talking about those who became vampires against their will... Or those who never became vampires but were arrested and exiled like Roxane and Stephane!
h: But why do you want that?

t: Worries? Alas, quite a lot. Most of all, King Louis de Desirae, head of House de Desirae and de facto ruler of all elves, has House de Doucer in his sights. That’s Prince Dakkar’s father, you should know. Dakkar himself, as you can see, separates Armando’s actions from those of other vampires. But Louis, in his day, confiscated the allod Nocturn from House de Doucer. Now he rules there and, of course, he is very opposed to its former owners’ return. In general, there are many in the League who remember what the vampires did... They themselves know that not everyone is ready to accept them. However, the current vampire leader, Wigo de Doucer, is apparently ready for talks.
h: And what worries you about this plan?

t: Go to the Seal and open it with the key you acquired.
So, we have the key... The last thing I want to do now is make some speech. I’ll just move us aboard Eclipse so we can finish what we started so long ago.
You did it! That means all that’s left is the final step – Nihaz’s Citadel.

The Seal is active, which means now Nihaz is throwing all of his power into stopping us. The space where the Citadel is hidden is massive, so until we get there, we have nothing to fear – Eclipse is quite safe. Anyway, you better talk to the captain about how you can help.
I... I still can’t believe we’re here. This place is simply not made for mortals. But our resolve is firm. Whether we can take this mission to the end depends on us alone...

Listen, … Don’t you think this has all gone too far?

I do! What are those bastards up to? They fly around here like they own the place and do whatever they want. I can’t stand it any longer!

Besides that, they ended up setting up base in the Crooked Outpost... which would have been a great place for Catherina’s plans for you and your business. That gang is out of place there. Perhaps it’s time to ask our guests to leave.

First, we need to gather the troops. We have a few more Clockwork Knights here, but those goblins managed to break them... Luckily, they are easy to fix using the artifact I give you.

But be careful. This is meticulous work, not some Empire junk you can fix with a hammer and file. If you break anything – I will personally make you pay up. Outright, in crystals.

Where is number five? I definitely remember the north was guarded by five knights, but only four returned. Was one beyond fixing? Or did you manage to fully break it?

Ah, here’s what happened, the Spark’s depleted... Technology isn’t as reliable as we thought. Too bad, we lost a good soldier. Now where do we find a new Spark for it without executing some local nobles again...
Get rid of the goblin hunters and goblin tormentors to the north of Clear Valley.

While the village remains defenseless from the north, you will have to protect it. Meanwhile, we’ll cover the rear from attack and teach them a lesson for damaging our Clockwork Knights.

Those wretches are catching local corrupted owls. But the problem is how they're catching them! They have cunning tormentors in tin helmets who apparently can use their thoughts to control minds. I’m not talking about the other hunters.

, I’m afraid you’ll have to kill the goblins and the corrupted owls. I hope that calms everything down.
This is good. We protected the rear. Now we can push the attack.
Eliminate goblin hunters and goblin tormentors to the north of Clear Valley.

I thought we took care of all the goblins, but no! Some of them managed to flee.

I don’t even know what holes they crawled into, , but they're back again and up to the same old mischief.

Apparently, it's worth the trouble.

Well, we have no choice but to drive them off again.
That’s good. Their brothers left in a hurry – about time.
Neutralize the turrets near the Outpost.

This shortling came in handy. He says the bridge leading to the Outpost is guarded by several automatic guns. To neutralize them, you’ll need a special device that you can get from the goblins guarding the bridge.

Move out and deal with those guns. I’ll examine the Knights and send my squad out right behind you.
Great work! The first squad is here. The rest are on their way – I sent for reinforcements. Thanks to you, the bridge is clear, and they can cross with no problem.
Gather 50 corrupted owl feathers for Archer Vostrov.

What do you think? Are there very many of these short foreigners in that fort? I think maybe fifty, no more. I’m a good shot, and I have enough arrows for each of them, but I better bring some extras just in case.

I’ll keep an eye on your prisoner. When you go after the goblins, bring me back some corrupted owl feathers while you’re at it for my arrows.

Oh, these are good feathers. Nice and strong! Maybe even better than eagle feathers.

I should tell the Keepers to leave some of these birds around.

Here is your payment.
Gather 35 corrupted owl feathers for Clear Valley archers.

I heard our archers prefer using corrupted owl feathers for their arrows. The best arrows fly straight and pierce deep.

Do me a favor, , and get me some more of those feathers.

Are we supposed to use astral cannons to shoot game? As they say, a cannon is fools’ novelty, but a trusty sword, a keen bow, and a hefty mace will never let you down.

Oh, these are good feathers. Nice and strong! Maybe eagle feathers would be better.

I should tell the Keepers to leave some of these birds around.
With Kork’s help, get into the Crooked Outpost and find out what the goblins are planning.

Reinforcements will soon arrive. But before we push these little troublemakers out of the Valley, I want to know why they came here in the first place. When the Leper took Umoir, everyone stayed away. But these guys jumped right into the thick of it, looking for diseased game. I want to find out why. Who is behind this strange hunt? And it wouldn’t hurt to find out what awaits us inside the Outpost. We need to scout it out.

The best agent to investigate goblins is another goblin. I want this shortling to get inside and learn what he can. Let him ask some questions, find some papers.

Talk to him.

Well, well... This must be Victoria Korleone? The daughter of Victor Korleone who wanted to overthrow Yasker? They say she was just a child when the Committee came for him. Did you have anything to do with that event?

After all, they say this Victoria is hell-bent on revenge for her father's murder.

Anyway, that's irrelevant. I think it’s time for some diplomacy – Eclipse style. That’s when we fly in on Eclipse, blast everything with the main cannon and then take away any survivors for execution. We just need to find out where this Victoria is and go pay her a visit. She’ll know how to get on Umoir!

And that goblin did pretty well. I hope he doesn’t betray us at the last minute like his comrades.
Hey, you! Pipsqueak! What’s your name? Ah, I don't care. Come on!

Ha ha ha! That’s some good fight! Nice!

If the villagers come bother us, we’ll show them our beasts too, he he...

What are you looking at? Are you waiting for me to pat your bald head?

Fine, I’ll give you a promotion. You will clean my boots!

Ha ha ha!
Help the engineer fix the astral sloop by handing him the right tools.

Can’t you see? I’m busy!

The boat’s engine failed. Now we can’t bring in our catch. Captain said if I don’t fix it by evening, he’ll screw off my head and hang it on the rudder!

If you don’t have anything to do, you can bring me the tools I need. Look alive! Or I’ll tell the captain it’s your fault the repairs are delayed.

Something is wrong!

Why is that? Because I don’t have a good apprentice! I have to do everything myself!

Here, I’ll fix it so we can get out fast, back to our Cuttlefish. If you need to, you can always land in the village...

That’s it, get out of here. Stop interrupting my work.

No, stop.

Take this core and get rid of it somewhere.
Sneak into the Outpost to sabotage it and open the gates

Scouting revealed that the goblins plan to unleash tamed leper animals on Zarida’s forces. Zarida is asking you to sneak into the Outpost again and release several leper animals from their cages to create a distraction. After that, open the gates and let her and her forces inside.
After you open the doors, Zarida and her troops run inside. Accompanying them is a Hero of Sarnaut that looks like our avatar. The warriors and knights go to battle and Zarida and the Hero of Sarnaut remain at the gates. The player regains control and appears as the “Hero,” and the goblin becomes our assistant.  (unrealized)
Deal with the goblins and ogres in Crooked Outpost.

Come, , forward! It’s time to clean up the Outpost.

I, of course, will take the lead role, but we’ll find work for you too. Look, if they’re running all over the Valley, then I’ll just have to catch them one at a time. I mean you will!

When you're finished, full command of the Outpost will be handed over to you and Zayan.
Why are you standing there? To battle! Advance!
We’ve really thinned their ranks! There are just a few left.
Take control of the guard turret and shoot goblins.

Listen, ! Maybe you've noticed we're being shot at here?

Yeah, yeah, there’s a gun up there. Go climb up and deal with it. I don’t really like being shot at.

Take this neutralizer. It will help you disable the shield. As soon as you take the gun, start using it. Let’s see how they like that.
We took the high ground! Time to rain fire down on them!
Finish with Captain Grot aboard the Astral Cuttlefish.

Listen, I wanted to ask... Why do you need all this stuff anyway? You’re just going to waste arrows and sorcery on them.

As my granny said – if you want to kill an ogre, cut off its head! And their head is Captain Grot. That... impostor! Just look at his beard! With a mug like that, he’s only fit to clean the latrines! That's what he was doing when he wasn’t convincing these petty traitors to mutiny.

Anyway! Shall we jump in the sloop and fly over to beat Grot’s face in?

Have a nice flight! I've dreamed of dumping this bastard in the astral for a year already.

Done! My baby is mine again.

Do you recognize me? Last time I saw you was on Eljune when I was still a lawful captain. But after a few years that latrine cleaner led a mutiny against me! Someone promised him mountains of gold in exchange for leper animals from these lands. I knew it was dangerous from the beginning. But he convinced the whole team to go along with it. I had to listen to that idiot after I was removed as captain...

But now we're all back to normal! We're flying to raid coastal settlements throughout the astral, merchant ships... With no damn menagerie on board. But, I guess they paid well? No, no, don’t even think about it. We’re done with Umoir!

I will be endlessly grateful for your help. Know this - we’re buddies now! And your fire lass too, yeah. Her... what’s her name... Tsarida? She’s a tough one, but that's alright with me! Tell her there’s always room for her in the captain’s quarters, he he...

Well, go ahead, pick your reward.
Meet with Jeer at the Outpost.

As you probably understand, Zayan and Dakkar are going with us.

How long will we be there? How long will the siege take?

Tep knows! Cosmos wants to have backup in case something goes wrong.

In short, we decided to gather all the undead in this world and put them under our banners. Zayan's elves will visit all the allods and subjugate all the dead they can find using Urd's knowledge.

But we need someone on Umoir, too. The Kanian Summoner Nawlad Jeer will gather them here. You know him... He mentioned something about you wrecking his estate. Was that true?

Anyway, you'll sort it out. By helping him, you are helping us all. So ignore his grumbling.

Ah, the hero arrives...

Well, , when are you going to pay me back for my estate?

What do you mean what do I mean?  Who let this idiot out of the dungeon? Don’t you know what a mess she created at my place? No?

You’re so gullible, . You’ll believe anyone. Do you ever use your head? Anyway... I have some things for you to do.
Find Captain Grot’s key and treasure.

The corner of a page is hanging out of Captain Grot’s pocket.  Upon further inspection, it turns out to be a map of the area, crookedly sketched by an orc hand. A square and a tree are drawn inside the outpost, and something resembling a key is above the lake. If you take a good look around, you could profit from this pirate’s treasure. The captain doesn't need it anymore.
Go to the Observatory on Cosmos’s Summons

You got a message! It says:

Greetings, Stormbringer!

You may remember, after your journey into the past, I sent my official representative to the Imperial Committee with an ultimatum - either they stop unnecessary military aggression against their neighbors in this world, or I will raze their nation to the ground and leave no memory of it in this world’s history. Alas, I had to take the same approach with the League.

Over the course of the next year, I managed to make significant progress in my relationships with your heads of state. Now they are ready to listen. And do what needs to be done.

We truly have achieved much already. I used the technological might of the Empire and the League’s resources to prepare for war. And then the hour came. I received the tidings I was waiting for. Come see me and I will tell you everything.
Answer Cosmos's summons and visit the Observatory
Go now, and I'll wait here.
I’m glad to see you in good health, Stormbringer.
As you can see, we have a small problem...

Infinity…

Nice name, right? That was the name of the Empire’s newest research vessel, built using the latest technology.

We need to know what our enemy is planning, right? Infinity was supposed to be our eyes and ears in the depths of the astral. They didn’t need to fight anyone. Just observe and record. But apparently something went very wrong.

And no matter how important the team is to us, right now our highest priority is to find out what happened.
h: What’s this message? Where is it from?

t: Find out why Cosmos summoned you to the Observatory.

There you are, Stormbringer!

Right on time, as always. Look here...
Now you know. One last thing.

That will be clear when we understand what we're dealing with.

And in order to understand, we need to go there and see everything for ourselves. That’s why I need you now.

Don't worry. You won’t be alone. You’ll have your own team. We just need to wait for its final member.
Go to the past and find the imperial research ship, Infinity.

I'd like to refresh some ground rules: you can't change meaningful events of the past that affected lives of many people. I'm speaking about the events that can be defined as turning points.

We mustn't change the course of history. We just need a very light disturbance. I'm afraid, you will have to face resistance.

To return, you will need the temporal inverter. I'll give it to you. As to the powerful energy source to activate it... I can't give you any. You'll have to find one yourself.

Here's the most important thing. Whatever you discover on that ship, remember, your mission is to find out what happened. Don't take any dangerous items or creatures with you into the future this time. Not even if someone really wants it!
I have goosebumps... we’re in the past!

Incredible! This is the first temporal inverter wormhole discovery in history!

Look, Stormbringer, that ship over there... I’m sure it’s Infinity!
Board Infinity using a jump pack and send the signal.

We found Infinity, but there’s a problem, Stormbringer... Nexus reported that a phenomenal amount of energy was spent to open the wormhole. The artillery couldn't take it and blew up, and the reactor overheated badly. Now we can’t even budge until it stabilizes, or we’ll explode.

But there is one way out... Ol’ Nogrom gave us jump packs. He said they’re almost entirely safe. They even have emergency flight controls. Luckily, we grabbed a few of them in case of unforeseen circumstances.

This is as unforeseen as it gets!

I already distributed the packs, and there’s one left for you. I wish you luck, Stormbringer, to you and your troops. Our team will escort you. When you’re on board, launch this signal rocket. It will let us know you made it.

This... was... a very hard... landing... Whew.

I didn't expect to be shot. Here... are so many dead bodies. What is this? A betrayal? A riot? I'll get everyone to the firing squad... As soon as I can get up.

Are you alright? Good. The Aoidos will respawn on Atreus, but you and I will have to deal with it on our own.
Find Sarang Meritneith and ask if there are any survivors.

, would you look at that... What a monstrous thing... What's behind that Seal? Mission Infinity is truly beautiful and dangerous!

So many dead... Look at their faces! Something horrible happened to them.

We need to find out what happened here!

All doors are locked shut, but I know this system: this is a sophisticated alert system that locks all doors on the ship...

Fortunately, I'm an Agent of the City Council. I know the codes that unlock any doors! Once I open it, we'll go down and find out what's going on there.

No! No, no... lock it...! They...!

Oh... you're not... not them?
Find out what happened aboard the Infinity

This is Infinity. Can anyone hear me? We need help!

But we didn't know... No one could foresee... They... all... died!!

No! Keep away!

This is Infinity. Can anyone hear me? We need help!

So that's how it is.

Cosmos! I can't believe it! He probably knew what awaited them here!

He was the one who spoke to Yasker and demanded that the Infinity traveled to these coordinates. He told us what to do, threatening to remove us from the timeline completely if we disobey.

I believe the Committee will have questions for this self-appointed Dominus of Creation when I get back!

And this Seal... It's dangerous! We must warn everyone to stay away from this place!

Come on,!

There's no time for discussion. We must leave the ship as soon as possible and get away from this Seal!

Let's evacuate the Infinity! Use any means necessary, and the sooner the better!
Our expedition achieved quite... an unexpected result...
Discuss the events with the Council and decide what to do next.

I'm afraid the things we feared have come to pass!

Our enemy didn't wait for us, he's ready to strike and make all our predictions about Sarnaut's end come true!

There's no time to waste. We have no choice. Either we find a way to defeat Nihaz and his darkness, or we perish.

I've gathered the brightest minds here. We'll decide what to do next!
The army will be ready, and you'll help me with that.

Well... Your story allows us to conclude that the Arisen are the reason. Their essence.

In recent years we've learned a lot about Tep's legacy, curse his soul. I received a report about the things they discovered on the so-called Wandering Island where Sarn's cultists were dealing with the Plague.

We know that Tep created his Plague using a shard of Nihaz's Seal. It must be the answer. After experiencing the effects of the Darkness once, we developed some kind of immunity to it.

It's just a theory, but it seems reasonable. I'm not willing to risk my brethren's lives by exposing them to this kind of influence, but if you encounter a creature that has lived through something similar, I ask you to run a test on it. We need to find out what these cursed demons are like... What are they made of?
h: We saw lots of their bodies but none of them were cursed. Even the Archdemon was unable to corrupt Sarang Meritneith's Spark.

t: Give the message to Zarida Zharova in Wellebell Preserve.

Remember Foul Dale?

Oh, it doesn't matter, anyway. You need to deal with a few things there while I'm studying this wretched demon. We need to know our enemy. Trust me, I know how to handle them, and this one is quite a peculiar fellow...

So.

Go to Wellebell and find my apprentice. She knows you, and you know her. Remember the Eclipse? Exactly.

This is a letter from me, it will bring her up to speed. Don't you dare peek inside!

Go now, don't dawdle.

I'm amazed you're not a frog. The Queen rarely jokes about curses. Or you really didn't read the letter?

Alright, I believe you.
Travel to the past and save the Infinity.

I'm afraid it's too late, Stormbringer. The signal is quite old, and the ship was never found. There's no one to rescue.
 But we have the Observatory and can disrupt the flow of time that led to that unfortunate event. Change the past and save the Infinity.
 You're an experienced time traveler now. On this journey, you'll be an anchor which will help others complete it safely. David will go with you - he knows the ship's crew. Tegorah and Hort Sobes will also accompany you - perhaps they will make a difference when you run into whatever doomed the ship.
What are you doing here? You need to be in the past right now, investigating the disappearance of the Infinity. To the Whirlpool, now!
Well, the rescue operation has been... somewhat successful.
Study the mysteries of the Citadel.

There are many reasons why I can't help you in battles against Nihaz's creatures, but that doesn't mean I have nothing to do here. While you're fighting, I'll do my best to sabotage the Citadel's systems and find out what Nihaz is hiding. I'll contact you every time you clear a level of the Citadel and kill the creature that controls it.
This place holds so many mysteries...

All the knowledge I've found here is... troubling. What happens to us when Nihaz's control is relinquished? Who exactly is Cosmos? I'm afraid we need to reach the end to find out.

Unfortunately, we must get past shields to move forward. We'll need time to disable them. A lot of time, perhaps. We'll have to wait.
Continue studying the mysteries of the Citadel.

How is the Great Ball going? You know, don't tell me. I visited it multiple times. Moonflower. Remember? Ah, never mind.

What is important, is that we're getting closer to something very dear to my father. The next levels of the Citadel store a lot of information. Included information from another world.

If you can move forward, I'll search the local terminals.
I think we'll learn the truth after the victory.

Perhaps you remember Daddy saying how he "tried to create various monsters when he was young - before he realized that brute strength always loses to dead reckoning".

You'll meet an example of whatever he was creating at the time. So, Hedus. What happens when you take the Void Dragon, corrupt it with darkness, rip it to pieces and force them to serve you?! Exactly, you get THIS...

Hedus is an example of that brute force. He's old, older than your world. Perfect Citadel Defender The fact that Nihaz abandoned him doesn't mean he'll be easy to defeat. On the contrary - I don't think you've encountered anything like that before. And he probably won't be alone.
Hedus! Thousands of worlds trembled before that name.

Hedus is defeated? It's hard to believe.

Well, you have proved you can handle gods and dragons...

Another part of the Void Dragon.

Avior is his mind. And quite a malicious one... that controls dark magic. He turns our nice little demons into spawns of darkness, corrupts Sparks and does most of Daddy's dirty work.

It's a nasty creature... He's yet to wreak havoc in your world, so consider yourselves lucky...

But I remember what Avior did. There's no vile thing his mind hasn't entertained. Destroy him - and you'll do me a great favor.

Ugh... When I think of his paws...
I have a bone to pick with Avior.

Is he finished?

Great, I haven't felt this kind of... vengeful glee for a while.

Nihaz, one day you'll pay for what you've done. For that cursed creature in particular!

But the hardest part is still ahead.

We defeated the power and mind of the dragon. What's left?

That's right. His soul.

Mirach is the essence of our Void Dragon. His soul, separated from the body and mind, never bowed before Nihaz. My father never needed it to bow or obey. He only had to lock it up in a cell to use as a source of power.

Thousands of years in captivity weren't easy. The dragon's soul became insane.

I feel sorry for Mirach, but we need to stop the torment to go further. Break the shackles that are holding him... and then act as you see fit.
It's a shame he wasn't strong enough to break free from jail.
Amazing! I imagine how hard it was.

Well, it's time to put an end to this story.

Remember my words: Nihaz, like Darkness, has many faces. He is just one of its countless facets. Nihaz is, how do I put it... The concept? The idea? The concept of conflict. The idea of war.

And at the same time - Nihaz is not the God of War.

A contradiction? No.

You see, there were Gods of Darkness before Nihaz. Rather, we can say that before Nihaz there were other Nihazes. It is a cycle, eternal and unchanging. The existence of the God of Darkness, which is the idea of conflict, is the same universal axiom as the idea of a fish. A fish is always a fish, even if it is a dolphin.

Do you disagree? Doesn't matter! In any case, we have to challenge him. Rather, his next avatar, Iranokh. Iranokh is the God of War. One of the countless facets of Darkness.

And, perhaps, one of the most powerful. It won't be easy to deal with him. But if we want to save our world, we have to do it.
The thing about Darkness is that it always loses in the end.

I can't believe it myself! The Citadel is under our complete control, and I was able to find what I wanted!

And what do you have here? Let me see...
Discuss the item with Klavdia and find a use for it

What a surprise!

A Control Cube - who could have thought...

Do you understand what this is?
The thing is too valuable to carry everywhere with you.

Do not be afraid - I understand the value of this thing and will dispose of it wisely.

Darkness has already changed my people once, and now this unexpected gift may grant us an opportunity to create a place where the Arisen will always be safe.

I'll hack it, but as for using it...

You won't be able to either, sorry. You need to be a Great Mage at the least. Give it to Catherina? It's dangerous, and I wouldn't want to distract her now. I have my own plans for the Queen of Umoir...

Aidenus and Yasker wouldn't do either - we don't want the League or the Empire to have a clear advantage, do we?

Well, the only candidate I can think of is Nefer Ur. He will keep everything a secret, and he is smart enough to use it wisely.

Give it to Nefer Ur - and keep quiet about what you have discovered. And I will contact you when it's time.
h: Perhaps you can hack it and give it to me?
